# Supplier agreement summary

<!-- p:16425160 -->
## Scope

<!-- p:3B212964 -->
The supplier will deliver cloud hosting services for the customer portal for a period of 24 months, starting on 1 January 2027.

<!-- p:12972045 -->
## Pricing

<!-- p:4B50F4CD -->
The monthly fee is EUR 12,500, invoiced quarterly in advance. Prices are fixed for the first year and may be indexed thereafter by at most 3% per year.

<!-- p:77B9C794 -->
## Service levels

<!-- p:69E36C9F -->
Availability is guaranteed at 99.5% per calendar month. Planned maintenance is announced at least 48 hours in advance and does not count as downtime.

<!-- p:058B17C9 -->
## Termination

<!-- p:6A70E1A8 -->
Either party may terminate the agreement with three months notice after the first 12 months. The customer may terminate immediately if availability falls below 98% for two consecutive months.

<!-- p:73D22116 -->
## Contacts

<!-- p:7C9523C2 -->
Questions about this summary can be sent to the procurement team.
